Da San Yuan Replay

Watch the bots play, row by row

This is Game 1 of our 1,000-game training dataset: a complete game from the East round to the North round, played under the team's rules (the dealer stays on after winning, or after a draw where nobody holds a kong). Every hand is replayed move for move by the same engine that made it. It plays on its own; pause any time to read a decision. Each time a bot has to decide, the engine saves one training row: what that player could see, the moves it was allowed, the move it made, and hidden answers used only to train the opponent reader. When the hand ends, the points each player won or lost are added to every row as the reward.

Each button is one hand: round wind and dealer number (1 to 4 within the round). "Repeat" means the dealer won or drew without a kong and dealt again.

What's happening

    Points so far

    Net points by play style over the hands finished so far. "Fed" counts hands where that style threw the winning tile. The last column is the average per hand across the whole dataset, for comparison.

    Play runs counter-clockwise from the dealer (East) at the bottom. Faded discards were claimed by another player. Seats with no possible claim pass automatically, so they are not recorded.
